errors.what: First pack-html put frontmatter fields (single_minded_proposition/budget_eur/persona) at top level; they did NOT land in shared/data.yaml (stayed 43 bytes, $schema only).
errors.recovered_by: Read pack.rs doc: frontmatter data must be nested under a `structured:` key. Re-authored frontmatter with `structured:` parent, re-packed; all three fields now present verbatim in shared/data.yaml.

problems_and_friction: The task spec listed the data fields flat, but clan pack-html only ingests them when nested under a `structured:` key in the YAML frontmatter. Had to inspect the SDK source to learn this. Also, --assets pointed at the whole work dir, so the parent files doc-fresh.clan and doc.clan got mounted as stray assets alongside logo-mark.svg; harmless but not clean. Followed the literal instruction for --assets.
context_understood: Hop 1 of 3 metamorphosis. Authored an HTML agency brief for Lumen (sustainable lighting startup) with structured data that must survive verbatim through later hops (concept deck -> client pitch). Packed from parent doc-fresh.clan into hop-01-agency-brief.clan carrying the logo asset and a new 3-field schema, with account-planner attribution. Verified: validate OK, logo present at human/assets/logo-mark.svg, and all three data fields intact in shared/data.yaml.
